csv_scope_of_work: City of Lee's Summit maybe seeking design for This project will improve sections of Langsford Road through access management. The project will add turn lanes, add medians to restrict turning movements, and reduce vehicular conflicts at key intersections: Noeleen, Bordner, Brentwood, Winburn and Crestwood. In order to sustain neighborhood access and emergency response access, the 5th Terrace gap will be closed. Curbs, sidewalks and lighting will be added east of Blackwell within City limits. This project supports the City s Livable Streets Policy, improves safety, improves access, and preserves roadway capacity.
